description: The preset browser for the Eagan Matrix instrument: search, filter by category and attribute, and load User or System presets; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Scans through the preset list one entry at a time, the same movement the up and down arrow keys give; control-shift-drag moves it finely, and clicking it loads the preset at the cursor
Loads the preset at the cursor on the instrument
Stops the MIDI keyboard chosen for navigation from moving the cursor, so it can be played without changing the selection

notes: the list stays empty until the presets have been scanned into a database, which is started from the Presets submenu of the Core actions menu on CHEM Core and takes up to an hour
nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
type in the search box at the top and press ENTER to narrow the list, which matches preset names and the raw metadata codes; ESC clears the text, and TAB moves between the box and the list
the search options hamburger beside the box picks whether names, metadata or both are searched, whether a match must fall at a word start, and whether the list updates on ENTER
metadata is searched as two-letter codes rather than words, so CL finds the Classic category and EP the electric pianos
the filter buttons narrow the list by Category, Type, Character, Matrix component and Setting; control-clicking one entry chooses that one alone, and a red lamp shows a filter is active
the preset actions hamburger sorts the list alphabetically, by category or by preset number, scrolls the playing preset into view or follows it, and keeps filters across sessions
the MIDI navigation button beside the knob picks a MIDI keyboard or controller and opens a dialog where each action is taught by MIDI learn: click between the brackets, then press a key
